verified: Electrek reported that Ford's BlueOval Battery Park in Michigan is now producing its first LFP (lithium iron phosphate) cells and shipping them to Kentucky to power Fathom prototypes; an earlier Electrek report said the plant had begun assembling LFP prismatic cells for Ford's upcoming EV lineup.
unconfirmed: How those prototype cells perform — capacity, range, charging — and when the Fathom actually launches and at what price. Electrek cites a $30,000 target, while other coverage cites $28,350, so the sticker is not settled; plant output volume and the extent of the CATL technology licensing behind the cells rest on outside reporting rather than a Ford disclosure.

verified: 据 Electrek 报道，福特位于密歇根州的 BlueOval Battery Park 工厂已下线首批 LFP（磷酸铁锂）电芯，这些电芯将运往肯塔基州，用于 Fathom 原型车的装车测试；这是福特首次自产该类电芯。
unconfirmed: 福特方面未就首批电芯下线作出公开确认，报道亦未给出电芯容量、能量密度、续航或工厂产能等任何规格数字，Fathom 的量产与上市时间表同样缺失；关于售价，Electrek 与另一篇报道称其为 3 万美元，一段第三方视频则称 28,350 美元，两种说法并存；工厂技术授权自宁德时代（CATL）的说法来自第三方报道与视频，福特未予证实；此外，这批电芯目前仅用于原型车，尚未进入面向客户的量产装车阶段。

titles.en: Ford starts LFP cell production, sends first cells to Fathom prototypes
titles.zh: 福特密歇根工厂投产首批 LFP 电池，先用于 Fathom 原型车
